title: LIVE WAVE DIRECTION
source_name: NOAA/NCEP Great Lakes Wave Unstructured v2.1 (GLWUv2.1, WAVEWATCH III) — WVDIR surface analysis
variable: WVDIR surface, analysis step (filed compass degrees 0-360 as-is, no conversion)
coverage: Lake water only: Great Lakes cut by the shared NOAA shoreline mask, land fully transparent.
arrows: Arrows show the toward-travel vector (filed FROM direction + 180 deg, standard oceanographic handling), white shaft with dark outline.
what: Mean wave direction on the lakes right now, in compass degrees exactly as filed by the NOAA wave model. Color tells direction at a glance; arrows show which way the waves are traveling.
why_extreme: Circular scale: north sits at both ends (dark-blue 0 and dark-purple 360 are both northerly); southerly waves own the middle oranges.
